verdict.rationale: Lithic documents the agentic use by name. It has an agentic-commerce solution page, and its MCP agentic-payments blog walks through creating a virtual card and configuring Authorization Rules for merchant categories, transaction limits and velocity. Rules and spend limits can be scoped to a single card. Missing for 10: any evidence of card expiry or time-boxed cards, merchant locks at the individual-merchant level rather than MCC/category rules, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-issued cards.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can give an agent its own card — issue a scoped virtual card to an AI agent with merchant locks, amount caps, and expiry so autonomous purchases stay inside policy, a use the vendor documents by name

citations.quote: Create a virtual card and assign it to a test account... Configure Authorization Rules controlling merchant categories, transaction limits, and velocity
secure and autonomous issuing, payments, and controls for AI-powered workflows
Lithic's Card and Account Spend Limits provide basic controls that help customers manage spend velocity.
